summary: Closed Phase 14 (Add Class, Tag and Cost-Class Selection to run-all.sh) [COMPLETED]. Added --class CLASS[,...], --tag TAG[,...], --cost-class CLASS[,...] to tests/run-all.sh, each opt-in and composing with --only and with each other by intersection. Zero new per-suite hand-authoring: --class reads the existing suite-classification.data column; --tag is mechanically derived from that same file's invokes:X[,Y] reason tokens plus a fixed 'lint' tag for test-lint-*.sh; --cost-class buckets the existing suite-cost-hints.txt wall_ms column at fixed thresholds (free/moderate/slow/unknown). The six new functions live in scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh as additive-only functions; every pre-existing function and the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel are untouched. Extended test-run-all-selection.sh with 12 new cases (14-25, all pass): 4 library-level correctness cases against the real corpus and 8 run-all.sh flag-level cases (selection, refuse-loudly-on-unknown-value, AND-composition) against a dedicated fixture. Confirmed --only/--jobs/--timings/--fail-on-new remain byte-identical absent the new flags. Documented the selectors in shell-script-testing.md. NET-PROD +318, NET-TEST +175, both net-positive and pre-justified in the plan as the mechanism that keeps the corpus from re-growing. The Tier Justification's literal command (verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 8) is a documented no-op (SKIP); real coverage came from a direct, unbounded verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 8 run and a direct run-all.sh --quiet full-battery run on the live, redeployed corpus: 168/175 passed, 7 failed (2 EXPECTED, 5 NEW), none referencing any file this phase touched -- logged as host-state-contention (multiple concurrent sibling orchestrate cycles were live throughout this session), not a regression. A separate transient gate10 timeout on one deploy verification run did not reproduce on immediate re-run. 6 of 20 plan phases remain, starting with Phase 15 (classify the markdown duplicate-block inventory and declare NET-MD).

artifacts.summary: Phase 14 close: added --class/--tag/--cost-class selection to run-all.sh, sourced from six new additive suite-selection-lib.sh functions, zero per-suite hand-authoring, 12 new regression cases, both net deltas net-positive and pre-justified.

Phase 14 close: key design decisions, the literal Tier Justification command's documented no-op, the full-battery host-contention finding, and the ~180s auto-background environment quirk for a future long gate-8 run.
